name: Daiei Kankyo
summary: Operating throughout Japan, Daiei Kankyo Co., Ltd. specializes in waste management and the recovery of valuable resources. Its comprehensive service portfolio includes waste treatment and recycling solutions, soil decontamination, energy generation from biogas, sustainable forest management, the construction and upkeep of facilities, and expert consulting. The firm also extends its reach into other waste-centric ventures, providing temporary labor and recruitment services, alongside its agribusiness activities. Additionally, Daiei Kankyo manufactures and markets recycled aluminum pellets and plastic pallets. Established in 1979, the company's headquarters are located in Kobe, Japan, and it operates as a subsidiary of Wingtowa Co., Ltd.
